privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draftNoticeBody: This page describes our current data practices in plain language, but has not yet been finalized with legal counsel. It will be reviewed and finalized before public launch.
privacy.overviewBody: JobConnect AI is a remote job platform that connects candidates with employers using AI-assisted tools. This policy explains what information we collect, how it's used, and who can see it.
privacy.collectAccountBody: your email address and password (used only for authentication), and whether you signed up as a candidate or an employer.
privacy.collectProfileBody: full name, professional title, bio, work experience, skills, education, location, years of experience, availability, work preference, LinkedIn/GitHub/portfolio links, and a profile photo, if you choose to add them.
privacy.collectPhoneBody: optional, and kept private — it is never shown to employers or other users.
privacy.collectApplicationsBody: the jobs you apply to and any message you include are shared with the employer who posted that job.
privacy.collectEmployerBody: company name and job postings, if you have an employer account.
privacy.collectPaymentBody: if you subscribe to Premium, payments are processed by Stripe. We do not store your card details.
privacy.aiToolsBody: The AI Resume Builder and AI Cover Letter Generator send the information you enter into those tools (target role, experience, skills, etc.) to a third-party AI provider to generate content —  for Premium accounts, or  AI for free accounts. This data is used only to generate your requested content and is not used to train these providers’ models on our behalf.
privacy.whoSeesBody1: Employers with an account can view your candidate profile — name, title, bio, skills, experience, education, location, links, photo, availability, and years of experience.
privacy.whoSeesBody1Bold: Your email and phone number are never shown to employers.
privacy.whoSeesBody1End: An employer only sees your application message if you apply to one of their job postings.
privacy.whoSeesBody2: Your profile photo, if you upload one, is stored in cloud storage that is reachable via a direct link — treat it like any other public profile picture, and avoid uploading anything you wouldn't want to be publicly viewable.
privacy.storageBody: Your data is stored with Supabase, our database and infrastructure provider, and is protected by row-level access rules that restrict most information to your own account unless explicitly shared as described above (e.g. with an employer you applied to).
privacy.rightsBody: You can review and update most of your information at any time from your <profileSettings>profile settings</profileSettings>. To request a copy of your data or to delete your account, contact us using the details below.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this policy as JobConnect AI evolves. Material changes will be reflected by updating the date at the top of this page.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy or your data? Reach out via our <contactPage>Contact page</contactPage>.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.draftNoticeBody: These terms describe our current practices in plain language, but have not yet been finalized with legal counsel. They will be reviewed and finalized before public launch.
terms.acceptanceBody: By creating an account or using JobConnect AI, you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the service.
terms.descriptionBody: JobConnect AI is a remote job platform connecting candidates and employers, with AI-assisted tools for resume building, cover letter generation, and candidate discovery.
terms.accountsBody: You choose a candidate or employer account when you sign up. You're responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for the accuracy of the information you provide — including your profile details and, for employers, your job postings.
terms.candidateFeaturesBody: Candidates can browse and apply to job postings, and use the AI Resume Builder and AI Cover Letter Generator to help draft application materials.
terms.employerFeaturesBody: Employers can post jobs and browse candidate profiles. Employers only see the professional information a candidate has chosen to add to their profile — never a candidate's email address or phone number.
terms.premiumBody: The Premium plan ($19/month) unlocks the AI Resume Builder and AI Cover Letter Generator , and is billed through Stripe. You can cancel anytime; access continues until the end of the current billing period.
terms.aiContentBody: Content produced by the AI Resume Builder and AI Cover Letter Generator is generated automatically and provided as a starting point. You're responsible for reviewing it for accuracy before using it in a real application — we don't guarantee the accuracy of AI-generated content or any job outcome.
terms.acceptableUseBody: Don't use JobConnect AI to post fraudulent or discriminatory job listings, submit false information, spam other users, or attempt to scrape or misuse other users' data.
terms.yourContentBody: You retain ownership of the profile information, applications, and job postings you submit. By using the service, you grant JobConnect AI the license needed to display that content to the other party it's intended for (e.g. showing your candidate profile to employers, or your job posting to candidates).
terms.terminationBody: You may stop using JobConnect AI and request account deletion at any time. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.
terms.disclaimersBody: JobConnect AI is provided "as is," without warranties of any kind. We're not liable for hiring decisions, job outcomes, or the accuracy of AI-generated or user-submitted content.
terms.governingLawBody: [Governing law and jurisdiction to be specified by JobConnect AI.]
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms as JobConnect AI evolves. Material changes will be reflected by updating the date at the top of this page.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these terms? Reach out via our <contactPage>Contact page</contactPage>.

aboutPage.heroTitle: Connecting global talent with companies that hire across borders
aboutPage.heroSubtitle: AI-powered remote job platform built for the borderless generation. Launched 2026 from Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
aboutPage.storyText: JobConnect AI was built solo by Stevenson Jean-Louis — a developer based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. The idea was simple: remote hiring is still broken. Candidates spend hours reformatting resumes for every application. Employers dig through profiles that don't tell them what they need to know. JobConnect AI exists to fix that gap with honest AI tools — no inflated scores, no fake matches.
aboutPage.value1Text: No fabricated matches. Every job listing is real, every AI score reflects a genuine assessment of your profile against the role.
aboutPage.value2Text: GDPR-compliant, EU-based AI for the free tier, and you control what employers can see. We never sell your data.
aboutPage.value3Text: 11 languages natively — not machine-translated afterthoughts. Built for professionals in every timezone.
aboutPage.teamText: Currently a solo founder: product, design, and engineering in one. Open to advisors and investors who believe remote work is the future of global hiring.
aboutPage.ctaText: Whether you're a job seeker, employer, advisor, or investor — we read everything.

chatWidget.greeting1: 👋 Hi there! I'm the JobConnect AI assistant. How can I help you today?
chatWidget.greeting2: Choose a topic below or type your question.
chatWidget.a_whatIs: JobConnect AI is a career copilot built for international professionals seeking remote jobs across borders. AI-powered tools + a curated remote job board — all in one place.
chatWidget.a_whoFor: JobConnect AI is built for ambitious professionals who refuse to let geography limit their career. Whether you're a developer in Vietnam targeting a Berlin startup, or a finance professional in Southeast Asia eyeing a Canadian firm — if you're chasing a remote career that crosses borders, this platform was built for you.
chatWidget.q_different: What makes JobConnect AI different from LinkedIn or Indeed?
chatWidget.a_different: LinkedIn and Indeed are built country by country. International professionals fall through the cracks. JobConnect AI is built from the ground up for the cross-border job seeker — every tool, every feature designed for someone applying across borders.
chatWidget.a_free: Yes! Browsing jobs and applying is free forever. Premium AI tools (Resume Builder, Cover Letter, Interview Prep and more) start at $19/month.
chatWidget.q_trial: Do you offer a free trial?
chatWidget.a_trial: Our free plan gives you job browsing, applications, and your candidate dashboard — indefinitely. Upgrade to Premium when you're ready. No trial period needed.
chatWidget.a_premium: Unlimited AI resumes & cover letters, ATS scoring, Interview Prep, Skill Gap Analysis, Career Coach, and country-specific formatting for US, UK, Canada, Germany and France — .
chatWidget.q_resumeBuilder: How does the AI Resume Builder work?
chatWidget.a_resumeBuilder: Tell us your target role, experience, and skills. Our AI generates an ATS-optimized resume tailored to the specific country you're targeting. A resume for Germany looks very different from one for the US — we handle those differences automatically.
chatWidget.a_detector: Our Remote-Friendly Detector analyzes every job listing to determine whether it genuinely welcomes international candidates — displaying a Likely / Unclear / Unlikely badge so you never waste time on the wrong applications.
chatWidget.q_skillGap: How does the Skill Gap Analysis work?
chatWidget.a_skillGap: Enter your target role and country. Our AI identifies your missing skills, relevant certifications recognized in that market, language expectations, and cultural norms. Market-specific intelligence, not generic advice.
chatWidget.q_coverLetter: What is the AI Cover Letter Generator?
chatWidget.a_coverLetter: It creates personalized cover letters tailored to the company, role, and target country's professional tone. A cover letter for a German company sounds very different from one for a British firm. Our AI knows the difference.
chatWidget.a_interviewPrep: Your personal AI interview coach. Get realistic interview questions — behavioral, technical, situational — with instant detailed feedback on your answers. Available 24/7, from anywhere.
chatWidget.a_careerCoach: A comprehensive analysis of your professional profile: ATS score, skill gaps, salary benchmarks, and a personalized roadmap to your next career milestone. A senior career advisor available 24/7.
chatWidget.a_copilot: Just type what you need in plain language — "Improve my resume for Amazon" or "Find remote jobs in France." Our AI Copilot understands your intent and takes you directly to the right tool, pre-filled. No menus, no friction.
chatWidget.a_countries: Our AI tools are fully optimized for five major job markets: United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, and France. Support for additional markets is coming soon.
chatWidget.a_anywhere: Absolutely. JobConnect AI is built for professionals based anywhere in the world targeting remote roles internationally. Your location is not a barrier.
chatWidget.q_fromOutside: Can I apply to jobs from outside my country?
chatWidget.a_fromOutside: Absolutely. Whether you're based in Asia, Africa, Latin America, or Eastern Europe — you can browse, apply, and land remote roles with top companies worldwide. Your location is not a barrier.
chatWidget.a_billing: Premium is billed monthly at $19/month. Cancel anytime — no contracts, no cancellation fees. If you cancel, you keep access until the end of your billing period.
chatWidget.q_cancel: How do I cancel my subscription?
chatWidget.a_cancel: Go to your account settings and cancel in one click. No phone calls, no forms. You keep full Premium access until the end of your billing cycle.
chatWidget.a_secure: Your data is protected by enterprise-grade security with Row Level Security. Your information is only accessible by you — we never sell your data or share it with third parties.
chatWidget.a_support: Email us at contact@jobconnect-ai.com — we typically respond within 24 hours.

faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about JobConnect AI
faqPage.a1: JobConnect AI is an AI-powered remote job platform that matches candidates with global companies that hire across borders. We offer AI tools including resume building, cover letter generation, skill-gap analysis, and Auto-Apply — all designed for remote-first professionals.
faqPage.q2: How does the AI matching work?
faqPage.a2: Our algorithm scores each job against your profile based on skills, experience, location flexibility, and cross-border hiring signals. You see a match score for every role so you can prioritize the strongest fits.
faqPage.a3: Yes — our Free plan is forever free and includes unlimited job browsing, applications, AI match scores, and a full candidate dashboard. Pro ($19.99/mo) and Elite ($39.99/mo) plans unlock AI resume building, Auto-Apply, and more.
faqPage.a4: We currently aggregate jobs from 63+ countries and support candidates from every timezone. Our Cross-Border Detector helps surface roles that explicitly welcome international applicants.
faqPage.a5: Auto-Apply (Pro and Elite) lets our AI apply to matching remote jobs on your behalf every day — up to 10 jobs/day on Pro, 25/day on Elite. It generates a tailored cover letter for each application and logs every action so you stay in control.
faqPage.q6: Is my data safe and GDPR-compliant?
faqPage.a6: Yes. We are GDPR-compliant. Your data is stored securely via Supabase, payments are processed by Stripe, and we never sell your personal information to third parties. You can request deletion of your data at any time.
faqPage.q7: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqPage.a7: You can cancel anytime from your account settings — no penalties, no questions asked. Your access continues until the end of the current billing period.
faqPage.a8: The Cross-Border Detector analyzes each job listing to determine whether the employer explicitly accepts international applicants (yes), requires local presence (no), or is ambiguous (uncertain). This helps you avoid wasted applications.
faqPage.q9: How is JobConnect AI different from LinkedIn or Indeed?
faqPage.a9: LinkedIn and Indeed are general-purpose platforms. JobConnect AI is built specifically for remote-first candidates who want to work globally. We combine job matching, AI resume tools, cover letter generation, and Auto-Apply in one place — with a focus on cross-border opportunities and honest AI scoring.
faqPage.a10: Email us at contact@jobconnect-ai.com or use the live chat widget in the bottom-right corner of the app. We respond to every message.

methodologyPage.metaTitle: How It Works — JobConnect AI Methodology
methodologyPage.metaDesc: Understand how JobConnect AI calculates match scores, detects cross-border eligibility, sources its job database, and defines its platform statistics.
methodologyPage.title: How JobConnect AI Works
methodologyPage.subtitle: Every score, signal, and statistic on this platform has a real definition. This page explains exactly how we calculate them — no black boxes.
methodologyPage.s1Intro: Each job listing is given a Match Score from 0 to 100 relative to your candidate profile. The score reflects how well the role fits you — not just on title, but across five weighted dimensions:
methodologyPage.s1p1Sub: How much overlap exists between your listed skills and the skills the job description explicitly or implicitly requires.
methodologyPage.s1p2Sub: Whether your location and working hours are compatible with the role's timezone restrictions, if any are stated.
methodologyPage.s1p3Sub: Whether the job description contains work-authorization requirements, residency restrictions, or payroll limitations that would apply to you.
methodologyPage.s1p4Sub: Whether your profile language and the job's required language(s) are aligned.
methodologyPage.s1p5Sub: Whether your stated years of experience and seniority level match the role's expectations.
methodologyPage.s1Outro: Match Scores are computed using OpenAI language models that analyze both the job description and your profile in full context — not just keyword matching. A score of 80+ indicates a strong fit. Scores below 50 are surfaced only when no better matches are available for your search.
methodologyPage.s2Intro: Not every "remote" job is truly open to international candidates. Our Remote-Friendly Detector reads each job description and flags roles that include restrictive language that disqualifies cross-border applicants.
methodologyPage.s2Intro2: We scan for four categories of restriction:
methodologyPage.s2p1Sub: Phrases like "must have US work authorization", "EU citizen only", or "right to work in UK required".
methodologyPage.s2p2Sub: Hard constraints like "must work US Eastern hours" or "must overlap at least 4h with CET" that may exclude certain regions.
methodologyPage.s2p3Sub: Requirements to be physically present in a specific country, state, or city — even for a "remote" role.
methodologyPage.s2p4Sub: Mentions of US-only payroll, W-2 employment, or restrictions on contractor arrangements that affect non-resident applicants.
methodologyPage.s2Outro: Jobs that pass all four checks are labeled Cross-Border Eligible. Jobs with partial restrictions are labeled Restricted with an explanation. This classification is a signal, not a legal guarantee — always verify eligibility directly with the employer.
methodologyPage.s3Intro: JobConnect AI aggregates listings from four verified job data sources:
methodologyPage.s3p1Sub: Global job aggregator covering 16+ countries with direct employer postings and structured salary data.
methodologyPage.s3p2Sub: Curated remote-first job board used by distributed companies worldwide.
methodologyPage.s3p3Sub: Remote job board focused on fully remote, async-friendly roles at modern companies.
methodologyPage.s3p4Sub: Free remote job board with international listings across tech, marketing, and operations.
methodologyPage.s3Outro: The database is refreshed every 6 hours. Duplicate listings (same role, same company, sourced from multiple providers) are removed automatically using title + company + description fingerprinting. Expired listings are removed within 24 hours of the source removing them.
methodologyPage.s4Title: Our Numbers — What They Actually Mean
methodologyPage.s4Intro: We surface three headline stats across the platform. Here is exactly how each one is defined:
methodologyPage.s4stat1Desc: The number of live jobs in our database that match at least one active candidate profile on any given day. This is not the total number of jobs in the database — it is the subset that generated at least one match above our minimum relevance threshold. The number is recalculated every 6 hours alongside the job refresh.
methodologyPage.s4stat2Desc: The number of distinct countries represented in registered candidate profiles. This reflects where our users are based — not the number of countries where jobs are available (which is broader).
methodologyPage.s4stat3Desc: The number of languages in which the JobConnect AI interface and content are fully translated: English, French, Spanish, Haitian Creole, German, Portuguese, Vietnamese, Chinese (Simplified), Japanese, Korean, and Arabic. Job listings themselves are not translated — they appear in the language posted by the employer.
methodologyPage.s5Intro: Every job on JobConnect AI receives a Cross-Border Score based on keyword signals found in the job description and title. The score is computed instantly, with zero AI calls, using four weighted signal groups:
methodologyPage.s5ThresholdHighSub: The listing explicitly mentions an EOR provider or visa support alongside international hiring language. Very likely open to candidates outside the employer's home country.
methodologyPage.s5ThresholdMedSub: The listing shows meaningful flexibility signals (async culture, global team, timezone openness) but lacks formal EOR or visa language. Apply with confidence but confirm terms directly.
methodologyPage.s5ThresholdLowSub: Insufficient signals detected. The role may still be international-friendly — verify directly with the employer.
methodologyPage.s5sig1Desc: The employer names an EOR or PEO provider, indicating they can legally employ people in countries other than their own.
methodologyPage.s5sig1Keywords: employer of record, EOR, PEO, via Deel, via Remote.com, via Rippling, via Papaya Global
methodologyPage.s5sig2Desc: The listing explicitly offers to sponsor visas or support work permits, strongly indicating cross-border willingness.
methodologyPage.s5sig2Keywords: visa sponsorship, work permit, relocation package, right to work, immigration support
methodologyPage.s5sig2Example: "We sponsor H-1B and EU work permits"
methodologyPage.s5sig3Desc: The role is explicitly async-first or imposes minimal time-zone overlap, making it accessible across regions.
methodologyPage.s5sig3Keywords: any timezone, async-first, fully async, overlap 2h, flexible hours
methodologyPage.s5sig4Desc: The employer signals an established practice of hiring across borders via team composition or explicit statements.
methodologyPage.s5sig4Keywords: global team, hire worldwide, open to international candidates, distributed team
methodologyPage.s5Outro: Scores are additive — a job that mentions an EOR provider and has an async-first culture scores 40 pts (medium). Each signal group contributes at most once regardless of how many matching keywords appear. The score feeds the ✅ / ◻ badge on every job card.
methodologyPage.footerNoteEnd: — we are happy to go into more detail.
